Messages.Author: Paul Heaver
Messages.Body:
Kherebutu (Bane mummy) says:
Kherebutu may play cards requiring basic Necromancy as a vampire
with a capacity of 3.

Can he use cards such as Soul Stealing, which says:
Only usable when a vampire you control burns a vampire controlled
by your prey.

And, when stealing blood, can it go to a life total greater than 3?

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Paul Heaver <phe...@attila.stevens-tech.edu> wrote:
>Kherebutu (Bane mummy) says:
> Kherebutu may play cards requiring basic Necromancy as a vampire
>with a capacity of 3.
>
>Can he use cards such as Soul Stealing, which says:
> Only usable when a vampire you control burns a vampire controlled
>by your prey.

Yes, since he plays the card as if he were a vampire.

>And, when stealing blood, can it go to a life total greater than 3?

Yes. There is no limit to an ally's life.
